name: skill-reviewer
description: Craft-first quality review for Agent Skill repos — LLM judges how well it is written, lint only filters packaging and security

plugins.name: skill-reviewer
plugins.description: Review any Agent Skill repo for how well it is WRITTEN, not just how well it packages. The primary judgment is an LLM craft review across four dimensions (L-001~L-004) — trigger design, writing quality, scope clarity, and anti-hallucination discipline; a deterministic lint runs first as a packaging/security filter, and its score is explicitly not a quality verdict. Output is a tiered profile — not pass/fail, but "which star-tier profile does this match, and what's missing to reach the next one". Grounded in a 97-repo star-gradient study whose finding — star count tracks packaging, not craft — is precisely why craft is judged by an LLM here rather than counted by a regex.
